name: xClaro
description: Adds a dark display (dark mode) to the core Claro admin theme.
project_description:
Admin Theme in 11.4 
 The new Admin Theme (aka Gin) is now available in Drupal 11.4.x, which support light and dark display modes.

 While some users prefer a darker interface than what the Admin Theme dark mode provides, xClaro may not receive any update to support a darker Admin Theme in dark mode. Final decision has not been made.

 Gin to replace Claro (older note) 
 Drupal core to adopt Gin admin theme to replace Claro.

 See: https://www.drupal.org/about/core/blog/drupal-core-will-adopt-gin-admin… 

 This project is minimally maintained until Gin is moved to Core.

 
 xClaro offers a lightweight solution for site administrators seeking a dark mode interface in Drupal. Designed as a module, it enhances the Claro administration theme without requiring a new theme installation.

 Features 
 xClaro provides:

 
 A dark color scheme for the Claro administration theme, improving usability in low-light environments. 
 A lightweight alternative to creating or using a standalone dark administration theme. 
 
 This module is ideal for administrators who love Claro but need dark mode for comfort or accessibility. It's especially useful for sites with frequent after-hours administration tasks or developers preferring dark UI themes.

 Note: the vertical blue navigation bar is provided by the xNavigation module 

 Post-Installation 
 After enabling the xClaro module ( Admin > Extend ):

 
 Navigate to Appearance settings. 
 Ensure Claro is the active administration theme. 
 Enjoy the automatic application of the dark color scheme—no additional configuration required. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 xClaro requires:

 
 Claro must be set as the administration theme. 
 
 No additional dependencies or external libraries are needed.

 Recommended Modules/Libraries 
 
 xNavigation : The perfect companion to xClaro. 
 
 Drupal CMS support 
 We support Drupal CMS. Make sure to switch the administration theme to Claro and enable this module.

 Similar Projects 
 
 Gin Admin Theme : Offers a highly customizable administration theme with a dark mode option. However, xClaro is specifically designed as a module add-on for Claro, keeping it lightweight and focused. Note that if you are using Drupal CMS, Gin will be installed by default in light mode. 
 Dark Mode : A module that toggles dark mode across the entire site, but xClaro is tailored exclusively for the administration pages. 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 Support development by contributing to the issue queue or promoting this module within the community.
